newsitem.title: UK: IPE NATURAL GAS MOSTLY STEADY, SELLERS RETREAT.
newsitem.headline: IPE NATURAL GAS MOSTLY STEADY, SELLERS RETREAT.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market steadied on Monday after a price fall on Friday, but offers were scarce, with sellers reluctant to trade at the new lower numbers.
Thirty lots traded in October which gained 0.02 pence to 10.970 pence a therm. September was offered at Friday's settlement level of 9.290 pence.
Next summer was fairly well bid just below Friday's closing levels, while bids were also posted in January and February next year, both at 18.360 pence.
